purpose: Fills a table that has no rows: says why with an icon, a title and a description, and offers the next step.

notFor.case: More pages remain to be fetched.

Default.visual: Icon in Content/secondary (Size/icon-lg); title in Content/primary (Type/label); description in Content/secondary (Type/body-sm); an optional action Button.

a11y.keyboard: No keys of its own; the action button is reachable by Tab.
notes: role="status" so the empty result is announced.

openQuestions: Load errors: is TableEmpty also the state for a failed load, or should the table show an Alert?
